name: The Siege of Blackford Keep
description: The lord who lost a crown at Blackford Ridge has spent an entire season turning a simple toll gate into a real holding, brick by brick. He has no crown to show for any of it and no plans to stay uncrowned much longer -- and unlike the goblin king, who's already answered for one theft, this one still has no idea who's been quietly deciding his fate the whole time.
epilogue: The Uncrowned's second army fared no better than his first did. He still doesn't have his crown back. He still has no idea the guild is the reason why.

name: The Bonewrought Vault
description: Something has been raising the dead again -- not one or two this time, but by the vaultful, row after row of them. Whatever's sealed inside is worth enough that a company of risen guards is still defending it centuries later, without pay, without rest, without ever once questioning the order. This isn't a job for one hero. Bring the whole guild.
epilogue: The vault held, in the end, for whoever the guild actually turned out to be. What was raised here has gone quiet again -- for now. Whatever tore open a road between the dead and the living to make this happen in the first place is still out there somewhere, and none of this so much as slowed it down.

name: Requiem for the Last God
description: The road the archive spoke of has no fixed heading and never did -- it opens for whoever means to walk it in a dying pilgrim's place, and closes the moment they stop meaning it. It has opened for this guild. Every guild that has taken this same walk before them left something behind to prove it: banners, hulls, ritual circles abandoned mid-rite, scattered across a shore that shouldn't exist on any chart and doesn't need to. Whatever's waiting at the end of that walk hasn't been walked in a very long time, and it does not entirely remember why anyone stopped.
epilogue: There is a difference between winning and being the one left standing when it is over. What the guild did at the end of that road wasn't a fight in the way every other fight has been a fight -- it was the last mile, walked the hard way, for something too far gone to make it easy. The guild is still deciding what to call that.

name: The Frozen Wyrmkeep
description: Something has been nesting in the high passes for longer than anyone noticed -- long enough to stop being one dragon and start being a brood. What used to be watched for avalanches gets watched for wings now, and lately there have been considerably more wings than there used to be.
epilogue: The brood is gone, and the ice it nested in is already creeping back over what's left of it -- which is, if nothing else, a tidier ending than Emberfell got. Nothing sings about a mountain that quietly stops being a problem. It just stops.

name: What Got Out
description: The demon lord is gone, but the fortress he held is still standing empty -- gate broken, wards down, nobody left to guard whatever else might want it. Word reached the guild slowly: something else moved in behind him, in the confusion, and it isn't interested in ruling anything. It's using the ruin exactly the way it's always wanted to -- as somewhere quiet enough to finish a working nobody's stopped it from starting.
epilogue: The breach didn't open -- not all the way, not this time. What was trying to open it scattered the moment the guild reached the chamber, which either means it was never as unified as it looked, or means whatever's on the other side isn't done trying. Either way, the fortress is finally, actually empty. The guild isn't taking bets on how long that lasts.
